breve: A visual shader node for shader parameter (uniform) of type unsigned int.
descricao: A VisualShaderNodeParameter of type unsigned int. Offers additional customization for range of accepted values.

propriedades.desc: Default value of this parameter, which will be used if not set externally. 'default_value_enabled' must be enabled; defaults to 0 otherwise.
If true, the node will have a custom default value.
